prayerExcerpt.en-US: If to fight for our country be glorious, "it is likewise great glory to follow the Lord," saith the Wise Man.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Se combater por nossa pátria é glorioso, "é igualmente grande glória seguir o Senhor," diz o Sábio.

meta.face: A Copt of about seventy-five with a deep-brown, sun-dark complexion and a LONG, HORSE-LIKE face — a HIGH, NARROW, deeply lined forehead under the hood, a LONG, BROAD-BASED nose with flared nostrils, the RIGHT EYE CLOSED under a smooth, long-healed lid, the LEFT eye large, dark and steady under a thick grey brow, LONG, FLAT cheeks, a WIDE, FULL-LIPPED mouth, a long jaw; a LONG, SQUARE-CUT grey-white beard; the gaze grave and unbowed. Not the wide, low, rounded-square macarius_alexandria, the square, big-boned james_nisibis, the bald, long-tapering paul_hermit, or the triangular anthony_abbot.
meta.basis: The Martyrology and Wikipedia say his right eye was put out and his left leg hamstrung under Maximinus; Santi e Beati gives as his emblem a bishop with the right eye lost. The card keeps the closed eye and the staff as quiet distinguishing marks, with no wound; the rest of the face is ours.
